description: This file defines the 'Probe' class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance. It appears to implement a network probe mechanism with multicast/broadcast capabilities, handling Web requests and responses, and managing instances with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class implementing network probing with multicast/broadcast capabilities, handling web requests/responses, and managing probe instances.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of web request data, particularly for M-SEARCH requests.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting M-SEARCH requests over the network via UDP datagrams, manages destinations and request creation.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web::Request data into a socket data frame for transmission.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web response based on incoming request data.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a broadcast ping with specified TTL.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares and sends data over UDP datagram.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Constructs a multicast request message, optionally signing it.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.
